content:
“Is there a doctor in the house?”

**First Aid** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Stimpaks restore more HP based on current Intelligence.

| ![FO76 first aid perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/9/91/FO76_first_aid_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Intelligence | Healing Bonus | 
| | 1 | +10% | 
| | 15 | +35% | 
| | 30 | +65% | 
| | 60 | +90% | 
| | 100 | +100% | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Stimpaks restore more HP based on your INT. | 0004C926 | 

- First Aid affects:
 - Electric Absorption
 - Healing salve
 - Nuclear Don's custom chem blend
 - Stimpak
 - Stimpak: diluted
 - Stimpak: super
 - Stimpak diffuser
 - Survival syringe
 - Restorative venison and tato stew
- First Aid is sped up by Field Surgeon, but the extra healing provided is unaffected.
- A First Aid card is found in Vault 76 on checkpoint pop-up number 6, labeled "Get a Job."
